identity.title: Emperor of the Crystal Tower: Entei Music Collection

leadText: Emperor of the Crystal Tower: Entei Music Collection (Japanese: の ピチューとピカチュウ ミュジックコレクション Emperor of the Crystal Tower – Pichu and Pikachu Music Collection) is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 3rd Pokémon movie, Spell of the Unown: Entei. It was released in Japan on July 8, 2000.
plainText:
Emperor of the Crystal Tower: Entei Music Collection (Japanese: の ピチューとピカチュウ ミュジックコレクション Emperor of the Crystal Tower – Pichu and Pikachu Music Collection) is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 3rd Pokémon movie, Spell of the Unown: Entei. It was released in Japan on July 8, 2000.

==Tracklist==
 }

==Trivia==
"Entei's Theme" reappears a decade later in the thirteenth movie as "The Legendary Beasts" and a portion of "Ruler of Illusions," the thirty-second and eighteenth pieces in Ruler of Illusions: Zoroark Music Collection.
